title: Senior Analyst, Salesforce
description_text:
LOCATION: Mexico
REPORTS TO: Global CRM Manager
Company Background: 
Ingredion is a Fortune 500 provider of ingredient solutions that helps nourish, comfort, sustain, and delight people around the world. Ingredion’s wide range of ingredient solutions is strategically designed to address changing consumer trends and preferences. Our specialty portfolio includes starch-based texturizers, clean and simple ingredients, plant-based proteins, sugar reduction and specialty sweeteners, and food systems. Our innovative ingredient solutions are used by consumers in everyday products, from foods and beverages to paper and pharmaceuticals. And we do it all in a planet-friendly sustainable manner.
We bring the potential of people, nature, and technology together to make life better.
The Sr. Salesforce Business Analyst will lead high value projects related to Salesforce in an agile development environment, working with business stakeholders, technical staff, and partners to deliver solutions that improve sales and sales support productivity and effectiveness through automation, process improvement, user experience, and analytics. The Sr. Salesforce Business Analyst will evaluate enhancement requests from end users to determine need, feasibility, and offer recommendations to optimize platform functionality and gain consensus among key business stakeholders on harmonized functional requirements with suggested prioritization based on anticipated business impact.
To deliver these solutions, the ideal candidate will become an expert in Ingredion’s business environment, how Salesforce is currently being utilized, and how it can be continuously improved to align with and support business objectives, strategies, and processes. You will lead requirements-gathering sessions, develop product roadmap recommendations, contribute to planning and prioritizing the work to be done, and oversee testing and change management activities and other project work required to bring solutions to light. Ideally you are a diligent, hardworking individual who learns new functions and processes rapidly, and consistently delivers outstanding results.
Additionally, the right candidate will advance CRM analytics to provide actionable insights for Go-To-Market teams and the broader organization to optimize business decisions and identify growth opportunities. This role is well-versed in business process documentation and will be expected to maintain documentation of CRM processes.
The position reports directly to the Global CRM Manager working closely with the Global IT function and Regional CRM business leads and other stakeholders to support an integrated approach to Commercial Excellence.
Core Responsibilities:

Work with the business to identify opportunities for driving sales productivity and effectiveness through technology, data, and process improvement.

Manage the product roadmap, prioritization, release planning, and delivery of key features for the business processes and technologies you oversee.

Perform the Senior Business Analyst role in often complex technical projects, overseeing requirements gathering, research, testing, deployment, documentation, training, communication, and user enablement.

Manage, track, and ensure the timely resolution of risks, blockers, issues, and bugs.

Review, test, and measure business impact of CRM enhancements to ensure they are providing business value and delivering expected ROI. Develop test cases and user acceptance testing (UAT) plans. Develop best practices for and oversee business user acceptance testing.

Stay current with Salesforce releases as well as relevant solutions and best practices in the marketplace, evaluating and implementing new features and solutions, as required.

Develop training materials and, in collaboration with Regional CRM Leads and Power Users, facilitate end user training sessions on the Salesforce.com application.

Measure and report on performance, achievements, and outcomes.

Participate in cross-functional teams that address strategic business issues involving CRM.

Partner with Salesforce and other partner vendor Customer Success management teams to drive engagement, adoption and utilization, and capability development.

This position is well-suited for you if you bring:

A passion for customers, demonstrated business acumen and digital first mindset

Experience managing and or implementing technology enabled end-to-end Customer Relationship Management and familiarity with Sales, Marketing and or Commercial processes

Understanding of the lead-to-cash processes, preferably within a B2B manufacturing environment

Process orientation with analytical skills to identify and tap improvement opportunities 

Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively and influence various levels of the organization across functions and or a variety of cultures/geographies

Attention to detail and ability to prioritize effectively within a fast-paced environment

Experience, working in a B2B environment and/or the manufacturing industry, preferably within the food, nutritional, specialty chemical industries or other relevant B2B environments

Qualified candidates will have:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

5+ years of increasing responsibility and impact in the areas of business analysis, product management, data analysis, system administration, solution architecture, or business intelligence

Salesforce certification is highly desired (e.g., Admin, Advanced Admin, Sales Cloud Consultant)

Deep Salesforce expertise, or translatable experience working with other CRM platforms, including system administration, user setup and maintenance, role hierarchy, profiles & permissions, security, page layouts, objects, fields, workflow, approval processes, formulas, queues, assignment rules, and data management

Experience with SAP or similar ERP system preferred

Ability to drive results through collaboration, influence, relationship-building, and teamwork

Experience with software development methodologies, tools, and best practices

Ability to work independently, with minimal supervision

title: Product Support Analyst
description_text:
This is a remote position.

The Product Support Analyst will support the Texas Education Agency (TEA). This role provides customer support, technical documentation, and user acceptance testing services for the Texas Student Data System (TSDS) and its associated data collections. The analyst will research and resolve support tickets, produce end-user documentation, and design and execute testing plans to validate system functionality and usability. This position also serves as a liaison between the Product Owner team and external customers, including Education Service Centers (ESC) and Local Education Agencies (LEA), particularly during peak data submission periods. 

Responsibilities:

Research and resolve technical support tickets related to TSDS and associated data submissions. 

Prioritize and escalate issues requiring deeper investigation or development team involvement. 

Serve as a point of contact for support-related meetings and communications. 

Create comprehensive and clear technical documentation for end users. 

Ensure documentation is accurate, up-to-date, and compliant with agency standards and accessibility requirements. 

Collaborate with the Product Owner team to gather information for documentation, including promotion logic guides, known issue reports, release notes, and newsletter updates. 

Design and execute user acceptance testing (UAT) plans to validate the functionality and usability of TSDS-related features. 

Document and track defects identified during testing, coordinating resolution with the Product Owner and Project Management teams. 

Gather and analyze end-user feedback to identify areas for improvement. 

Assist the Product Owner team with customer outreach during peak TSDS data submission timeframes, and document and present issues reported by ESC and LEA customers. 

Requirements
Minimum Qualifications:Candidates must meet all minimum qualifications. 

8 years of experience working with the Texas Student Data System (TSDS) at the LEA/vendor level.

8 years of experience in customer service, with strong communication skills. 

8 years of experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. 

8 years of experience using excellent communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. 

8 years of experience demonstrating a high level of accuracy and attention to detail in documentation tasks. 

8 years of experience training other team members. 

Preferred Qualifications:

8 years of experience documenting software issues, release notes, and technical guides. 

8 years of experience creating clear, concise, and comprehensive technical documentation. 

Work Location and Schedule:

Location: 100% Remote, within the United States. 

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, excluding State holidays. 

Work Arrangement: Telework.

title: Manager, Healthcare Analytics
description_text:
At Swoop, our mission is simple: Improving patient outcomes. As a market leader in AI-driven, data-powered, and privacy-compliant healthcare engagement, we connect the signals that drive earlier diagnosis, better treatment decisions, and sustained adherence.

Our integrated, privacy-safe platform, enables life sciences companies to drive measurable patient and commercial outcomes with actionable intelligence — spanning patient and HCP audience targeting, community engagement, AI-powered web solutions, coordinated omnichannel activation, and prescription fulfillment.

We believe our people are our greatest asset. Swoop fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, providing employees with rich opportunities for professional growth. This commitment to our team earned us the "Best Places to Work" recognition from Business Intelligence Group in 2025 and 2026. We are driven by a patient-first philosophy and passionate about leveraging technology to create a healthier future. 

After becoming an independent company in 2024, Swoop experienced significant growth and demonstrated an unwavering commitment to innovation, talent development, and enhancing the patient experience. Our acquisition of MyHealthTeam in January 2025 and Nimble in May 2026 helped us further bridging the gap between healthcare brands and patients for more impactful and targeted engagement. Empowering millions of patients nationwide to connect, share resources, and access medically verified information to better manage their health. MyHealthTeam hosts the largest and most engaged patient social networks in healthcare, offering more than 70 condition-specific communities for chronic and rare conditions. As a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform, Nimble empowers independent and regional pharmacies to deliver a modern, consumer-friendly healthcare experience while streamlining pharmacy operations.

If you're a driven professional seeking to make a real difference in healthcare marketing at a fast-growing, innovative company, join Swoop and help us revolutionize how brands connect with patients and HCPs. 

About the role

The Manager, Healthcare Analytics is a senior individual contributor within Swoop’s Product Innovation Team.They own analyses end to end — from a loosely defined question raised by a client-facing team, through the cohort logic and QA, to the narrative that goes back — working across claims (RWD), social determinants of health (SDOH), pharmacy and treatment data, and user-generated content (UGC).

The Manager will wear many hats, from defining and executing against requests to setting direction for the function. They will transform repeatable work into reusable method: the codesets, definitions, and templates the rest of the team builds on. They will also mentor other team members and help set the bar for analytical rigor across the team.

What you'll do

Own healthcare analyses end to end. Scope an ambiguous request, define the patient or provider cohort, write the SQL, QA the result, and deliver an answer a nontechnical stakeholder can act on.

Serve as the data subject matter expert, partnering directly with sales, client strategy, and ad operations to shape the question before the analysis starts.

Build and govern the reusable building blocks of the analytics practice — condition and treatment codesets, cohort and metric definitions, notebook templates, and documentation — so every result is reproducible by someone other than its author.

Design patient and healthcare provider (HCP) audience segments from real-world data, and hand them off with the definitions, counts, and caveats needed to act on them.

Turn analysis into client-ready deliverables — market landscape, competitive and switching dynamics, payer access, patient journey, and audience recommendations — and present them to internal leadership and client stakeholders.

Measure and report the impact and performance of Swoop’s campaigns and community engagement initiatives to internal and external stakeholders.

Apply AI and generative AI tooling to accelerate analysis and reporting, and share what works with the broader team.

Identify and propose new methodologies, data sources, and analyses — including opportunities the business has not thought to ask for.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in data analytics, including a track record of owning projects independently from question to delivered answer

Strong working knowledge of healthcare data — medical and pharmacy claims, diagnosis and procedure coding, NDC and treatment data — and of the healthcare industry

Advanced proficiency in SQL, with hands-on experience on large data sets and cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery)

Demonstrated ability to turn a loosely specified request into a defined, defensible analysis and to say plainly what the data can and cannot support

Experience with data visualization tools and techniques, and comfort building the story around the numbers

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable recommendations for nontechnical and senior audiences

Experience mentoring or reviewing others’ analytical work

Familiarity with pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare marketing work — brand strategy, competitive analysis, patient journey, or audience targeting

Familiarity with Python, SQL, notebooks, and version control (Git) for reproducible analysis

Curiosity and passion for data exploration and healthcare innovation

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities

H2 Performance Consulting (H2), a high-growth technology firm, is seeking a Senior Solutions Analyst to support a U.S. government client. The Senior Solutions Analyst will lead analysis of Federal missions, operating environments, business processes, systems, data, controls, and user needs and translate findings into practical, traceable solution requirements and recommendations. This is a fully remote position supporting a government client. The position requires U.S. citizenship and an active Public Trust clearance at the time of application. Key Responsibilities: 

Plan and lead discovery, business analysis, systems analysis, and solution-definition activities for complex Federal initiatives. 

Assess agency missions, authorities, policies, operating models, workflows, systems, interfaces, data, controls, performance measures, and stakeholder requirements. 

Elicit, analyze, reconcile, prioritize, document, and validate functional, nonfunctional, data, integration, security, privacy, accessibility, reporting, and operational requirements. 

Develop current-state and future-state process maps, system context diagrams, data flows, interface definitions, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, requirements traceability matrices, and decision artifacts. 

Evaluate solution alternatives based on mission value, user impact, technical feasibility, cost, risk, compliance, implementation effort, interoperability, and sustainment.

Maintain bidirectional traceability from statutory, policy, contract, program, user, and technical sources through requirements, designs, tests, releases, decisions, and outcomes. 

Distinguish business needs, solution requirements, design choices, assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, and decisions. 

Analyze quantitative and qualitative evidence to identify root causes, gaps, duplication, bottlenecks, control weaknesses, data-quality issues, and mission-delivery risks. 

Apply human-centered CX design principles to understand user roles, journeys, accessibility needs, pain points, and adoption considerations. 

Assess how legacy systems, vendor products, application programming interfaces, data sources, infrastructure, and security boundaries affect solution feasibility. 

Develop clear artifacts that are usable by executives, program personnel, end users, designers, engineers, testers, acquisition personnel, and oversight organizations. 

Perform work in accordance with applicable contract requirements, security controls, privacy protections, records-management requirements, and agency policies.

Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in business, industrial engineering, operations research, organizational development, public administration, systems engineering, or related field.

Pax8 is building the technology marketplace of the future, connecting partners, vendors, and small to midsized businesses through intelligent technology, comprehensive product support, and a culture where people can do meaningful work.

Coordinate across the business: Bring together Product, Engineering, Sales, Finance, Support, Vendor Alliances, and other teams to move priorities forward.

Keep stakeholders aligned: Facilitate productive meetings and communicate timelines, decisions, risks, open questions, and launch readiness with clarity.

Resolve platform challenges: Investigate vendor and product issues, coordinate bug resolution, and keep the right people informed through to completion.

Improve how work gets done: Identify repetitive or high-friction processes and implement thoughtful automation, artificial intelligence-enabled workflows, or redesigned processes.

Support long-term vendor success: Partner with the Vendor Launch team to create smooth handoffs and establish vendors for effective lifecycle management.

🌟 The Impact You’ll Make

Your work will help Pax8 build dependable, scalable vendor relationships and create a more seamless experience across our marketplace. By connecting vendor needs with the right technical and operational teams, you’ll reduce friction, improve launch readiness, accelerate issue resolution, and help internal stakeholders make better decisions.

You’ll also have the opportunity to leave a lasting mark by introducing smarter ways of working that reduce manual effort and give the team more time to focus on high-value vendor and partner outcomes.

Excellent critical-thinking, task-management, and organizational skills.

A clear, adaptable communication style that works across individual contributors, senior leaders, vendors, and technical teams.

Confidence managing several priorities while maintaining urgency, accuracy, and visibility.

Demonstrated experience using artificial intelligence-enabled tools, automation, or process redesign to strengthen operational outcomes.

Curiosity about emerging technology and the judgment to apply it to practical business challenges.

The self-awareness and initiative to ask thoughtful questions, learn quickly, and operate independently.

A bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.

Experience with data analysis, Structured Query Language, coding concepts, product-management practices, Microsoft vendor relationships, or vendor distribution models would be a bonus. A project-management or process-improvement certification is also welcomed but not essential.

title: Senior Growth Marketing Analyst
description_text:
About the Job:
At LaunchDarkly, our Product-Led Growth (PLG) motion is evolving rapidly. We are looking for an experienced, highly analytical, and strategic Senior Growth Marketing Analyst to help us decode the digital body language of our prospects and users.
In this role, you will leverage wide-ranging experience across GTM disciplines to help build, optimize, and scale our PLG engines. Reporting to the Principal Growth Marketer or Director of Growth Marketing, you will resolve complex data and operational issues requiring an in-depth evaluation of variable factors mapping user and account signals across channels, establishing the "next best action" for high-value leads, and optimizing conversion pathways. You will act with a high degree of independence to determine methods and procedures on new assignments, collaborating across Marketing, Product, RevOps, and Data engineering teams to drive function-impacting results.
Responsibilities:

Data & Signal Strategy

Audit, track, and categorize 1st-party, 3rd-party (e.g., 6sense, GitHub), and product/marketing signals across target contacts and enterprise accounts.

Evaluate variable factors and intangible data nuances to distinguish technical practitioner actions (e.g., SDK deployment) from broader enterprise intent (e.g., security evaluations).

Partner cross-functionally with Data Engineering and RevOps to clean, enrich, and continuously source high-intent signal data.

Feed signal combinations, recency, and frequency into predictive models to refine lead routing and account prioritization.

Activation Strategy

Use signal combinations to define the right "next best action" for accounts and individual users based on their segment, ICP fit, and stage (e.g., prospect vs. existing customer).

Map and trigger appropriate activation responses ranging from personalized marketing content to white-glove outreach from Product Advocates or automated handoffs to SDRs and Enterprise AEs.

Operational Motion & Cross-Functional Integration

Act as the primary business lead to cross-functionally implement, refine, and maintain activation workflows across Marketing, Product, Sales Ops, and Data teams.

Apply an understanding of the interrelationships between different disciplines to navigate complex cross-team dependencies and drive strategic alignment.

Help define and iterate on sales-facing tools (such as a "single pane of glass" interface) that surface product affinity, app usage, intent signals, and account fit to enable sales execution.

Maintain structured feedback loops with Product Advocates, SDRs, and sales reps to assess lead quality and continuously refine signal logic.

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Experimentation

Analyze and optimize conversion rates across the end-to-end flow—from initial signal capture to activation, handoff, and pipeline generation.

Independently design and run growth experiments (in-product onboarding adjustments, messaging, routing logic) to maximize engagement and move accounts through the buyer journey.

System Administration & Technical Tooling

Manage technical configuration, tracking setups, and ongoing maintenance for core data and analytics platforms (e.g., GA360/GA4, customer data platforms, product analytics).

Maintain rigorous data flow standards and proper tag/tracking setups across web properties, marketing tools, and product analytics environments.

Qualifications:

Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years of related experience in growth marketing, marketing analytics, revenue operations, or PLG strategy within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Cross-Disciplinary Expertise: Deep understanding of B2B SaaS growth tactics, PLG motions, marketing technology stacks, and revenue analytics, with a proven ability to bridge Marketing, Sales Ops, Data, and Product management.

Independent Problem Solving: Proven track record of independently determining methods and procedures on complex, ambiguous assignments requiring evaluation of variable factors.

Technical: Hands-on proficiency with web analytics (GA360/GA4), product analytics (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel), CDPs, SQL, and CRM/automation platforms.

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:

Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $136,500 - $187,660**

Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $122,800 - $168,850**

Zone 3: All other US locations - $116,000 - $159,500**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.
*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

title: Business Analysis, Acquisitions - Principal Analyst / Manager
description_text:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're looking for a Principal Business Analyst to shape how new customers find Mission Lane, reporting to the Director, Growth.

The impact you'll make:

Getting approved for a credit card is often someone's first step toward building credit, and that can put a car, a home, or whatever's next within their reach. As Principal Business Analyst, Growth, you decide where and how we spend so more people find Mission Lane when they are ready for that next step. You'll manage test investments at a meaningful scale, weighing the credit risk on each one, and you’ll run the day-to-day strategy and relationship with one of our biggest affiliate partners.

Mission Lane is still young, but we've landed in an exciting, stable stretch of maturation. We're still building but we've already got a solid foundation. There's never been a better time to learn and grow right along with us.

As Principal Business Analyst, Growth you will:

Design and size acquisition tests, whether that's a new channel, a new customer segment, or a new offer, and make the call on how big a swing is worth taking

Analyze the credit risk on a test before it launches: what the downside looks like if it underperforms, and whether that downside is one we can live with while we learn, reviewing the biggest bets with your manager before they go

Own the day-to-day operations of third party relationships.

Work with acquisition partners to keep those channels performing, from placement and pricing to the data terms behind them

Track a test's performance while it's live, so you catch one running hot on risk or cold on response before it burns through its budget

Partner cross-functionally with engineering and product and marketing as you launch tests with net-new products or capabilities. i

Share your strategy and results directly with senior leadership

You'll thrive in this role if:

You've spent time in financial services, so weighing credit risk, compliance, and regulatory considerations into a decision isn't new territory for you

You're comfortable being accountable for real money: you can make the case for a test's exposure as confidently as you can make the case for its upside

You're curious enough to dig into the reasoning behind your own analysis, down to the assumptions it's built on, so you understand it at an elemental level

You take ownership of your work end to end, catching your own mistakes before they compound

You can explain a business problem clearly enough that someone outside your immediate team could follow your thinking

Minimum qualifications:

2+ years of experience in a highly analytical role

Financial Services Industry experience

A bachelor's or master's degree in economics, finance, engineering, mathematics, or a similarly quantitative field, with a strong academic record

A track record of solving open-ended business problems: framing the question, forming a hypothesis, working through the data, and defending your recommendation to stakeholders

Comfort working in SQL, Python, or similar tools for data analysis

Ability to travel ~4-6+ times per year for high quality in-person collaboration

Preferred qualifications:

Experience working with credit cards or other consumer lending products

Experience helping scale a business in a fast-moving startup environment

Strong SQL or Python skills

Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, etc.)

Compensation:

Annual full-time starting base salary range: $118,000 - $135,000

This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.

Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

About Mission Lane:

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia. 

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn’t have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn’t do.

In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.

description_text:
TELUS Digital AI Community
Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Every day, billions of people search for music, shows, and apps across global platforms. They type a query expecting to find exactly what they're looking for. But those search results only make sense if AI understands not just the words people search for, but the cultural meaning behind them. Your deep knowledge of how people in your market actually consume media — which shows matter to which communities, how music preferences shift across regions, what streaming platforms mean to your culture — is the bridge between what people search for and what algorithms learn to recommend. That cultural translation is irreplaceable.
A Day in the Life of a Media Search Analyst
In this role, you will evaluate how well media search results align with real user intent across multiple search modalities. Your analytical judgment determines whether AI systems understand not just what people search for, but why they search, and whether the results truly serve their cultural and entertainment context. 

Parse complex media intent queries across streaming platforms, music catalogs, and application ecosystems understanding that the same search term carries different meaning across regions and age groups 

Validate multilingual asset metadata and cross-attribute search parameters (release dates, artist affiliations, regional availability, cultural context) 

Evaluate search result relevance against detailed evaluation frameworks that account for local market nuance, regional preferences, and cultural interpretation 

Apply structured reasoning to edge cases where metadata conflicts or cultural context shifts meaning 

Provide detailed assessment feedback that trains media search algorithms to better reflect local culture and user intent 

Why this matters: When media search algorithms understand local culture, discovery becomes accurate and meaningful. Listeners find the right music, viewers discover relevant shows, and cultural expression is reflected authentically in digital systems. ﻿

title: Risk Analyst
description_text:
Risk Analyst / Risk Manager – Remote
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (flexibility for reporting cycles, audits, and incident response)
About the Role
At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Risk Analyst / Risk Manager to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate financial, operational, compliance, and strategic risks across the organization.
This role focuses on building risk frameworks, conducting quantitative analysis, monitoring risk exposure, validating controls, and delivering actionable insights to leadership. You’ll work closely with finance, operations, compliance, IT, legal, and executive teams to strengthen governance and support informed business decisions.
What You’ll Do
Risk Identification & Assessment

Conduct enterprise-wide risk assessments across financial, operational, compliance, cyber, and strategic risks.

Identify emerging risks, vulnerabilities, and control gaps.

Maintain risk registers and track remediation efforts.

Recommend practical risk mitigation strategies.

Risk Analysis & Modeling

Build and maintain quantitative risk models using SQL, Excel, Python, R, SAS, or similar tools.

Perform stress testing, scenario analysis, and forecasting.

Analyze trends, incidents, and operational risks.

Support data-driven risk management decisions.

Compliance & Controls

Monitor compliance with regulatory frameworks and internal policies.

Support internal and external audits.

Test and validate internal controls.

Ensure documentation remains audit-ready.

Reporting & Dashboards

Develop dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools.

Prepare reports highlighting key risks, trends, and recommendations.

Present findings to leadership and governance teams.

Translate complex risk data into clear business insights.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with finance, operations, compliance, legal, IT, and business teams.

Support governance initiatives and policy improvements.

Promote risk awareness across the organization.

Required Experience & Skills

3+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, audit, governance, or financial analysis.

Strong SQL, Excel, and data analysis skills.

Experience with GRC platforms such as Archer, ServiceNow, LogicManager, or similar.

Familiarity with enterprise risk frameworks and regulatory requirements.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Nice to Have

FRM, CFA, CPA, CCEP, CRISC, or related certifications.

Experience with VaR, stress testing, Monte Carlo simulations, or operational risk analysis.

Background in financial services, fintech, healthcare, SaaS, or insurance.

Experience supporting executive or board-level reporting.

Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.

Exposure to cyber risk, vendor risk, or enterprise governance programs.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Review dashboards and identify emerging risks.

Run quantitative models and scenario analyses.

Update risk registers and monitor remediation efforts.

Perform control testing and compliance reviews.

Prepare reports for leadership and governance committees.

Collaborate with business teams to improve risk management practices.

In short: You’ll identify, assess, and mitigate organizational risks while helping leadership make informed, risk-aware decisions.
Key Metrics for Success

Timely and accurate risk reporting.

Controls tested and validated on schedule.

Reduction in unresolved or repeat incidents.

Audit readiness and regulatory compliance.

High-quality executive reporting and documentation.

Early identification and mitigation of emerging risks.

Interview Process

Application Review

Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)

Practical Assessment (Risk Analysis or Reporting Scenario)

Client Interview

Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply
After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.
Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your risk management experience, and highlight your background in risk analysis, compliance, governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.
You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.
Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.
Apply Now
If you enjoy identifying risks, analyzing complex data, strengthening controls, and helping organizations make informed business decisions, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build a proactive, resilient risk management program.

description_text:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.
Job SummaryThe Workforce Analytics team provides reporting tools, analysis, and insights that empower leaders to make key people decisions and drive business value. Partnering with HR, finance and business leaders, the Senior Workforce Analyst builds scalable reporting tools, analyzes workforce trends, and applies statistical and visualization methods to deliver insights that drive strategic decision-making across the organization.

The Senior Analyst, Workforce Analytics is a hands-on role - deeply consultative, but always in the data - solving complex workforce and business challenge. This individual will partner closely with HR, Finance, Technology, and business leaders to understand the problem behind a request, ask the right questions, analyze data, and determine the appropriate solution rather than simply completing assigned reports or building dashboards. The role requires someone who is comfortable working in ambiguity and gray areas, can independently take an undefined problem and work it through to resolution, and knows when to collaborate with others to move an issue forward. The ideal candidate combines strong people analytics, dashboarding, and technical skills with curiosity, resourcefulness, critical thinking, and strong interpersonal skills, and can translate complex data into a clear story that helps leaders understand what is happening, why it matters, and what actions they should consider.
Job Description

The ideal candidate combines strong people analytics, dashboarding, and technical skills with curiosity, resourcefulness, critical thinking, and strong interpersonal skills, and can translate complex data into a clear story that helps leaders understand what is happening, why it matters, and what actions they should consider.

Desired Skill Set

People & Workforce Analytics – Experience analyzing workforce data and translating findings into meaningful business insights.

Consultative Problem-Solving – Ability to work through ambiguous problems, ask the right questions, identify root causes, and develop solutions.

Stakeholder Partnership & Collaboration – Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to partner effectively across HR, Finance, Technology, and business teams.

Data Analysis & Visualization – Advanced Excel, SQL, and Power BI/Tableau skills with hands-on dashboard and reporting experience.

Data Storytelling & Communication – Ability to translate complex data into clear insights, recommendations, and compelling narratives for leaders.

Ownership & Resourcefulness – Proactive, hands-on approach to investigating issues, navigating gray areas, and driving problems through resolution.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor’s degree in technical, quantitative, or business-focused fields (Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or a related field).

Licenses/Certifications: (None)

5+ years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, or a related role.

Experience in workforce / people analytics strongly preferred; familiarity with HR/HCM data structures required

2+ years with hands-on experience with HCM report and dashboard design and development; Oracle HCM experience strongly preferred.

Experience in Strong ability to apply statistical models, forecasting techniques, and workforce analytics methodologies.

Advanced proficiency in Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools (PowerBI, Tableau)

Excellent communication and storytelling stills, with proven ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations for senior leaders.

Strong analytical mindset with expertise in project management, stakeholder management, critical thinking and problem solving

Principal Accountabilities

Partner with HR, Finance, Technology, and business leaders to understand workforce challenges and translate them into data and reporting needs.

Lead complex workforce analyses using statistical models and advanced analytics to assess key HR metrics, forecast trends, and support strategic decision making.

Own workforce reporting and analytics solutions end-to-end – from consultation and scoping through the requirement definition, build, validation, and delivery.

Transform data findings into clear, compelling narratives that drive strategic decision making.

Ensure data integrity by leading quality efforts, verifying analysis, and maintaining high standard of precision

Identify opportunities to enhance data systems and reporting capabilities, working closely with Technology and other stakeholders

Mentor and provide technical guidance to analysts.

Stay current on industry trends and best practices in workforce analytics and data science.

title: Data Analyst
description_text:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: London

About the Team

The Cloudflare Data Intelligence & Analytics (DIA) team has built a unified data & ML platform to provide our internal Business Partners with actionable analytics, insights, and recommendations.

Our goals are to:

Democratize data & intelligence for humans and agents

Build a context layer and an AI systems layer upon our unified data & content platform

Support Cloudflare’s critical business needs

DIA is a ~ 75-member strong geographically distributed but organizationally centralized team. This role is within the growth & adoption analytics pod based in London that works across several business functions, offering broad exposure to Cloudflare's entire business.

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Analyst in London to scale our growth & adoption analytics initiatives. You will be a trusted data advisor to our business partners, a technical coach to your peers, and the lead in terms of shaping AI-first data models, workflows, and agent-ready-datasets.

Success in this role will rely on marrying a strong analytics background with product and business acumen to deliver highly strategic and compelling insights that accelerate growth and influence adoption. This role also requires a deep understanding of data infrastructure, job orchestration, and lineage, all with the use of AI-tooling as default.

Role Responsibilities

Own the development and maintenance of agent-ready curated datasets end-to-end

Provide analytics support and a strategic perspective to our business partners

Partner with data engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to enable data-driven answers to key business problems

Review Merge Requests created by your team of humans and agents

Take initiative to gather requirements, define, build, and maintain pipelines and metrics

Tell easily digestible and highly actionable stories with data to help stakeholders understand analytical insights

Role Requirements

B.S. or M.S in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or other quantitative fields

Demonstrable proficiency with analytics-relevant AI-tooling

4+ years experience in a centralized data analytics teams in close partnership with business stakeholders

Expert-level proficiency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries is mandatory, with a proven ability to performance-tune complex queries and manage analysis workflows against large, petabyte-scale datasets (Candidates will be assessed on advanced SQL skills including window functions and common table expressions (CTEs))

3+ years experience working in version control environments using platforms such as Gitlab or Github

2+ years experience working with job orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, both as a pipeline developer and reviewer

2+ years experience with data ingestion and transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt, Fivetran, or custom/in-house developed platforms)

Initiative, curiosity, strong stakeholder engagement, and empathy

Experience translating business questions into analysis frameworks, converting results into business recommendations, and presenting those to stakeholders

Nice-to-Have Experience

Experience and/or a keen interest in internet security, protocols, and edge-development

Analytics experience in a fast-growing technology, SaaS, or subscription-based business

Experience with statistical analysis programming languages (Python, R etc.)

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

title: International Payroll Analyst
description_text:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

Reddit is seeking an experienced, highly analytical International Payroll Lead to own and scale our international payroll operations across LATAM, EMEA, and APAC regions. As a key individual contributor with deep cross-functional influence, you will combine data-driven execution, meticulous attention to detail, and international tax compliance to support a rapidly growing workforce. Reporting to the Sr. Global Payroll Manager, this role will help to drive major strategic initiatives—including Workday enhancements and global payroll vendor implementations—to build scalable, best-in-class operational processes. The role partners closely with Payroll Vendors and internal teams across People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Equity, and Internal Audit to deliver accurate, timely, compliant, and employee-centered payroll outcomes.

What You’ll Do:

International Payroll Execution & Oversight: 

Manage, audit, and execute multi-country payroll delivery across 15+ international countries, including payroll inputs, validation, approvals, funding coordination, reconciliations, statutory filings, and post-payroll activities ensure high accuracy and strict adherence to strict regional pay schedules.

Lead the payroll calendar and operating cadence across countries, proactively managing dependencies, cutoffs, exceptions, and risks to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.

Partner with local in-country payroll providers to maintain strict adherence to regional pay schedules and statutory processing windows.

Compliance & Equity Management: Oversee international equity compensation payroll processing (RSUs, Stock Options) and ensure full regulatory compliance across international tax jurisdictions, localized statutory benefits, and reporting requirements.

Systems & Scaling Initiatives: Act as functional lead for payroll technology projects, leveraging Workday to automate workflows, optimize system configurations, build custom reporting, and partner with the Sr. Global payroll Manager to implement upcoming enterprise Global Payroll solutions.

Cross-Functional & Vendor Management: Partner with Benefits, People Operations, Legal, and Finance; manage external vendor relationships and third-party tax fulfillment partners to ensure seamless funds reconciliation and local tax compliance.

Process Controls: Establish, document, and enforce global payroll policies, SOX controls, and standard operating procedures to streamline audit readiness (401k, Workers’ Comp, Financial Audits).

Strategic Growth Projects: Support special business initiatives, including M&A integrations, new country market entries, and business-critical cross-functional launches.

What We’re Looking For:

Experience: 5–7+ years of progressive payroll operations experience in a high-growth, publicly traded tech company with a global footprint.

Education : Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in payroll, accounting, finance, human resources, or a related field.

Systems Expertise: Advanced proficiency with Workday Payroll (reporting, configuration, integrations) and global payroll software platforms.

Technical & Analytical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (vlookups, index/match, pivot tables) for complex data analysis, reconciliation, and audit modeling.

Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of global equity taxation, statutory compliance, international labor laws, and multi-currency payroll distribution.

Execution & Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving capabilities, high discretion handling confidential data, and exceptional communication skills to collaborate seamlessly across teams.

Bonus Points

Responding to internal, external, statutory, and financial audit requests, including preparation of reconciliations, control evidence, and supporting documentation.

Applying automation or AI tools to payroll operations, analytics, controls, case management, or knowledge documentation.

Providing high-quality customer service to employees and business partners across regions, cultures, and time zones.

Working in a publicly traded, technology, or high-growth company and supporting international expansion or payroll transformation.

How Success Will Be Measured

Operational Excellence: Accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery across the international footprint.

Audit & Governance: Strong controls, clean reconciliations, and audit-ready documentation.

Vendor Management: Reliable vendor performance and effective resolution of payroll issues.

Scalability: Scalable processes, improved automation, and clear country-level operating documentation.

Stakeholder Satisfaction: Trusted partnerships and a responsive, employee-centered service experience.

Benefits:

Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

401k with Employer Match

Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

Family Planning Support

Gender-Affirming Care

Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

Generous Paid Parental Leave 

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

title: GTM Strategy & Operations Analyst
description_text:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Build, improve, diagnose, fix, and measure things. Have outsized impact in your role supporting a rapidly scaling sales organization! The GTM sales team at Stripe works with new and existing businesses of all shapes and sizes. As a member of the Central Sales Strategy and Operations team, you’ll be responsible for overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with senior sales leadership and the broader sales team to provide insights and analysis on core business performance metrics and drive key strategic sales initiatives.

What you’ll do

Partnering closely with the GTM leadership team, regional sales leaders to support sales teams, owning the in-depth monitoring and tracking of the business metrics, creation of key intelligence and insights to accelerate growth. 

Partner with key cross-functional stakeholders, including but not limited to Marketing, Finance & Strategy, Data Science, Seller Systems, and Strategic Operations to streamline and optimize our internal processes and run-the-business and planning deliverables (Stripe Rhythm of Business: Weekly Business Reviews, Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews). Shape the processes and go-to-market support model for a rapidly growing company, and make a tangible impact on sales and operations.

Responsibilities

Support the GTM leadership with intelligence and insight to accelerate growth

Support Sales Strategy and Operations colleagues by standardizing global and regional common process that is currently decentralized

Deep dive into key performance metrics and drive deep understanding of business performance

Problem solve and structure analysis outcomes for complex sales operations challenges through data, analytics and insight

Identify new opportunities and areas of productivity efficiency gains for Regional sales leadership

Participate in projects defining go-to-market approaches, as well as in regular business and resource planning

Run analysis on key performance metrics, providing relevant insights for managing the business

Oversee implementation of enabling systems and tools, working closely with internal systems teams

Prepare weekly senior leader forecast materials and provide ongoing updates on key business growth/metrics to leadership teams

Manage bespoke projects and effectively manage stakeholders

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

Has 7+ years of sales, strategy and operations experience in a high-tech growth environment, or operational experience in investment banking or management consulting or private equity or venture capital, or business insights / analytics roles

Advanced proficiency in SQL and other advanced analytics tools

Proficiency in BI visualization tools

Experience leveraging AI to analyze data / derive insights, automate processes, or create reports / dashboards

Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality

Works well with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, often ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment

Preferred qualifications

Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/software company

Prior experience in the payments industry

title: Optimisation Data Analyst
description_text:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Optimization Data Analyst

We are seeking an experienced Optimization Data Analyst to play a critical role in driving scalable optimizations and advanced analytics across Adyen’s global Performance Optimization team. As a mid-level analyst, you will independently lead complex analyses, support automation and experimentation projects, and collaborate with commercial and product stakeholders to deliver actionable insights that maximize merchant growth.

This role is ideal for an experienced analyst looking to deepen technical impact while influencing product and business outcomes at scale.

What You’ll Do

Data-Driven Optimization: Analyze large-scale payment datasets to identify performance trends, uncover optimization opportunities, and deliver high-impact recommendations to our biggest customers, while identifying and driving scalable opportunities that benefit the broader merchant base.

Scalable Tooling & Automation: Design and build scalable analytics solutions, automation pipelines, and self-service tools that empower internal teams and stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Data, and Commercial teams to translate business challenges into analytical solutions, driving continuous platform improvements.

Advanced Problem-Solving & Experimentation: Lead complex A/B testing and data investigations, shaping data-driven strategies and validating hypotheses with analytical rigor.

Strategic Data Storytelling: Drive strategic discussions by synthesizing complex data into compelling narratives, tailoring insights for technical and non-technical audiences, and positioning the Performance Optimization team as a key business enabler.

Mentorship & Best Practices: Support knowledge-sharing within the Performance Optimization team, contributing to the elevation of analytical standards and technical excellence.

Who You Are

3–5 years of relevant experience in a data analytics, data science, or similar role, ideally in fintech, payments, or a high-growth tech environment.

Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark, with hands-on experience in large-scale data processing.

Ability to design and develop efficient and scalable ETL and data pipelines for datasets, including the use of data validations to ensure reliability.

Familiarity with big data tools (Spark, Airflow) and version control using Git.

Solid experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau) and dashboard development.

Deep understanding of statistics, hypothesis testing, and data mining.

Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence product and business outcomes.

Proactive, self-directed, and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, global environment.

Excellent communication and storytelling skills, translating data insights into business value.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Professional experience in HR, Payroll, and Benefits operations.

Background in maintaining Workday business processes, security protocols, system releases, notifications, and automated mass operations.

Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, macros, modeling.

Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, collaboration.

Experience conveying complex technical concepts and data findings into clear, accessible recommendations for non-technical partners.

description_text:
About Acquia

Acquia empowers the world’s most ambitious brands to create digital customer experiences that matter. With open source Drupal at its core, the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) enables marketers, developers, and IT operations teams at thousands of global organizations to rapidly compose and deploy digital products and services that engage customers, enhance conversions, and help businesses stand out.

Headquartered in Boston, MA, Acquia is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company, is listed as one of the world’s top software companies by The Software Report, and is positioned as a market leader by the analyst community. We are Acquia. We are building for the future and we want you to be a part of it!

Career Exploration at Acquia

Our recruitment process is designed to empower you in making the most informed decisions. Acquia is committed to providing an inclusive, transparent, efficient, and educational interview experience that cultivates exploration into career opportunities at Acquia

You will discover the opportunity to grow your career here and learn from a global team that empowers you to exceed boundaries and achieve the extraordinary.

Acquia is the digital experience platform built for a world where your audience isn't only human. Its agents too.

Powered by agentic AI that orchestrates — not just advises — Acquia automates complex digital workflows within the governance guardrails large organizations require.

The world's #1 Drupal hosting provider, Acquia brings together Content Management, Digital Asset Management, and Product Information Management in a single AI-powered Command Center: Acquia Source.

Acquia. Built for every audience, human or otherwise.

The Role: Acquia is seeking a Staff AI Engineer to join our Data & Intelligence function. Acquia runs one of the largest Drupal and digital experience footprints in the world, and holds more than a decade of operational, product, and customer data across it. This role exists to put that data to work: building the retrieval, graph, and inference layers on top of our data platform, and the agentic and deterministic systems that turn the resulting signals into action for our customers and our teams.

The remit is broad. Our function spans observability, our core data platform, and insights and intelligence, and you will work across all three alongside the product and platform teams that consume what we build. Scope moves with company priorities, so we are looking for someone comfortable changing context and picking up an unfamiliar problem. Much of what you build will be shared capability that several teams depend on.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will spend most of your time designing, building, and shipping production systems, and you will lift the AI engineering capability of the teams around you through the quality of your work rather than through management overhead. We ship early and iterate.

Key Responsibilities

Write and ship production AI code daily. You are an active contributor.

Lead our work on making customer context retrievable at speed, across semantic retrieval, indexing, and knowledge graph approaches over our data platform. An early priority is letting an agent resolve a customer and pull its full context in a single request. Where that work goes from there is partly yours to define.

Build the inference and signal layer: models and processors that read from our Iceberg-based lakehouse, write scored inference back, and expose signals through contracts other teams can build against.

Take signals through to action, turning detected conditions such as churn risk, usage and entitlement mismatch, or expansion opportunity into workflows that act, with human review where that is the right design.

Choose the right tool for each workload: a large model, a small fine-tuned model, or ordinary deterministic code. Managing inference cost is part of the job.

Own evaluation and observability for our AI systems, so we can show a signal is sound before anyone acts on it.

Set the patterns other teams build against, and work with engineering and business leaders to turn company goals into shipped systems.

How We Think About Experience

We are more interested in how you learn than in the tools already on your CV. Our stack spans Python, SQL and dbt, distributed query engines, durable workflow orchestration, an Iceberg lakehouse on S3, and a changing mix of model providers and agent frameworks. It will look different in a year. We expect you to arrive without deep expertise in some of it and to close that gap fast, using AI to read unfamiliar codebases and get to a useful contribution before you are fully fluent. Range across languages, data platforms, and model providers counts for more with us than years inside any single one.

Required Experience

8+ years of software engineering, including 3+ years shipping AI or ML systems to production.

Strong programming fundamentals and deep proficiency in at least one language used for AI and data work. Python is our primary language for ML and insights.

Fluency working with data at scale — advanced SQL, a transformation layer such as dbt, and a distributed query engine over lakehouse or warehouse storage, including reasoning about query cost and partitioning.

Production retrieval and context engineering — embeddings, vector search, hybrid or graph retrieval, and measuring whether retrieval is actually working. Experience modelling entities and relationships across multi-source data is valuable here.

Agentic systems and durable workflows in production, with tool calling, state and memory, and human-in-the-loop patterns. We use Temporal and LangGraph; equivalent experience transfers.

Evaluation and observability for AI systems — tracing, prompt and version management, and dataset-driven testing, whatever the tooling.

Cloud deployment experience (AWS preferred) with containerized services, and ownership of inference cost.

B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Desired Skills

Experience standing up shared data or ML capability that other teams then built on.

Small and fine-tuned model work, including distilling task-specific models to replace general-model calls at scale.

Observability data fluency: OpenTelemetry, and logs, metrics and traces at very high volume, including what it takes to make that data queryable.

Data governance instincts around access control, lineage, and data residency, treated as part of the design.

Enterprise SaaS or CMS, including familiarity with Acquia's Drupal-based DXP.

Agentic development workflow fluency: AI-assisted coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) as everyday accelerators, and MCP or similar for connecting agents to real systems.

Strong communication skills — able to present AI system design to both engineers and C-suite stakeholders.

Senior IC track record — known for the quality of your own code and system designs, with mentoring that happens organically through great work, not through meetings.

We are an organization that embraces innovation and the potential of AI to enhance our processes and improve our work. We are always looking for individuals who are open to learning new technologies and collaborating with AI tools to achieve our goals.

Acquia is proud to provide best-in-class benefits to help our employees and their families maintain a healthy body and mind. Core Benefits include: competitive healthcare coverage, wellness programs, take it when you need it time off, parental leave, recognition programs, and much more!

Acquia is an equal opportunity (EEO) employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veterans status or any other protected status or characteristic under federal, state or local law unrelated to the ability to perform the job.

We are seeking an AI-Native candidate who treats AI not as an external tool, but as a fundamental extension of their cognitive workflow. The ideal candidate possesses an orchestration mindset—the ability to skillfully prompt, manage, and direct AI to navigate complexity—and maintains a high degree of AI fluency.

You should be characterized by radical adaptability and a “builder” mentality, showing a restless drive to transform traditional work processes into agentic workflows. Beyond technical proficiency, we value intellectual humility: the willingness to constantly unlearn old methods in favor of more efficient, AI-augmented processes. You don't just use AI to do your job; you use it to redefine what your job can achieve.

Pay Range
$150,000—$200,000 USD
