The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for designing and implementing the data workflows, integrations, and pipelines that connect enterprise manufacturing, ERP, PLM, MES, and quality systems into a cohesive, governed data ecosystem. This role is critical to enabling end-to-end traceability, operational visibility, and regulatory compliance across multi-site manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience integrating complex enterprise platforms in regulated manufacturing environments, is fluent in data engineering best practices, and can operate effectively across engineering, operations, IT, and compliance teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with high organizational visibility and direct impact on production operations. This is a remote role based in the US and requires the ability to maintain or obtain a DOD clearance. 

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise System Integration

Design, build, and maintain data integration workflows connecting MES, ERP, PLM, QMS, and supporting enterprise platforms.

Develop and own integration pipelines between systems such as Apriso (Delmia), NetSuite, ForProject, Empower, and 3DX PLM.

Architect and implement API-based, event-driven, and batch integration patterns across cloud and on-premises manufacturing systems.

Build and maintain data flows that support production execution, material management, traceability, scheduling, and quality processes.

Partner with ERP, MES, and PLM implementation teams to design integration points, data contracts, and transformation logic ahead of go-live milestones.

Support multi-site rollout strategies by building reusable, configurable integration templates that can be replicated across facilities.

Manufacturing Data Workflows & Traceability

Design data workflows that support grain-level and sublot traceability across the full manufacturing lifecycle.

Build pipelines that enforce compliance checkpoints including pot life hard stops, e-signature requirements, and hold point validations.

Integrate with LIMS systems to support quality data capture, lab result ingestion, and traceability linkage to production records.

Support automated generation of regulatory document packages (travelers, WARPs, and production records) through structured data workflows.

Develop integrations with PLC/SCADA and automated traceability systems where applicable.

Data Pipeline Development & Architecture

Build and maintain scalable ELT/ETL pipelines for operational, analytical, and compliance reporting workloads.

Architect data flows from source systems through transformation and serving layers with full lineage, observability, and auditability.

Implement data quality frameworks including validation rules, anomaly detection, and SLA monitoring across all pipeline stages.

Define data models, naming conventions, and integration standards in collaboration with the Enterprise Architect and platform teams.

Manage infrastructure-as-code for data integration resources using Terraform or CloudFormation.

Compliance & Regulatory Data Support

Ensure all data workflows and integration designs support applicable regulatory and quality standards including AS9100, DCMA, ATF, and ITAR/EAR.

Build audit-ready data trails and evidence packages that satisfy regulatory inspection and certification requirements.

Partner with compliance, cybersecurity, and quality teams to ensure data handling controls meet organizational and contractual obligations.

Enforce CUI data classification and handling requirements across all integrated systems and pipeline stages.

S. Person required, as defined under ITAR/EAR.

Cloud & Infrastructure

Administer and optimize cloud data services across Azure Government and AWS GovCloud supporting manufacturing data workloads.

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for deploying integration artifacts, data pipelines, and configuration changes across environments.

Write and maintain automation scripts in Python and/or PowerShell to support integration operations, data validation, and workflow automation.

Monitor integration health, data freshness, and pipeline performance; implement proactive alerting and self-healing mechanisms.

Collaboration & Documentation

Work closely with operations, engineering, IT, and compliance stakeholders to translate manufacturing requirements into data integration solutions.

Create and maintain thorough documentation for all integration designs, data dictionaries, workflow diagrams, and compliance evidence.

Participate in architecture reviews, sprint planning, and cross-functional implementation working groups.

Serve as a technical resource and mentor for junior data engineers and integration analysts on the team.

Technical Skills

MES, ERP & Enterprise Platforms

MES: Apriso (Delmia) - production execution, material management, traceability, regulatory enforcement; DELMIA manufacturing operations

ERP: NetSuite - manufacturing, inventory, procurement, and financial data integration

PLM: 3DX (Dassault Systems) - product lifecycle, BOM, and engineering change integration

Supporting: ForProject, Empower, or equivalent program/project and compliance management platforms

Quality: LIMS integration, QMS platforms, CAPA, FAI/FAIR data flows

Data Integration & Pipeline Tools

ETL/ELT pipeline development - Azure Data Factory, Apache Airflow, dbt, or equivalent

API integration - REST, SOAP, GraphQL, OData; MES and ERP vendor API experience

Event-driven integration - Azure Event Hubs, Service Bus, Kafka, or equivalent messaging platforms

iPaaS / middleware - Azure Integration Services, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, or equivalent

EDI and flat-file integration patterns for legacy manufacturing system connectivity

Cloud Platforms

Azure Government: Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, ADLS Gen2, Azure Functions, Azure Monitor

AWS GovCloud: S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, RDS

Compliance configurations for regulated cloud environments

Scripting & Programming (Required)

Python - pipeline scripting, API integrations, data transformation, automation

PowerShell - infrastructure automation, Windows/Azure environment scripting

T-SQL / Spark SQL - complex query development, data modeling, transformation logic

PySpark - distributed data processing for large manufacturing datasets

Data Architecture & Modeling

Relational and dimensional data modeling - star schema, snowflake schema, operational data stores

Manufacturing data models - BOM structures, routing, traceability hierarchies, lot/serial genealogy

Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) for operational and analytical workloads

Data lineage, metadata management, and cataloging - Microsoft Purview or equivalent

DevOps & Source Control

Git - version control, branching models, code review workflows (required)

CI/CD - Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions

IaC - Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep

Docker / Kubernetes basics for containerized integration workloads

Industrial & Automation Systems

PLC/SCADA data integration - OPC-UA, historian databases (OSIsoft PI or equivalent)

Automated traceability system integration - barcode, RFID, vision system data ingestion

Manufacturing execution data patterns - work orders, routing steps, material consumption, quality holds

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next. 

Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field highly preferred or will consider equivalent work-related experience with certifications. 

12-15 plus years of data engineering or enterprise integration experience, with significant time in manufacturing or industrial environments.

Demonstrated hands-on experience integrating MES and ERP platforms in a production manufacturing setting.

Experience supporting regulated manufacturing environments (aerospace, defense, ATF-licensed, or equivalent).

Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-system integration projects from design through production go-live.

Experience supporting multi-site technology rollouts strongly preferred.

Security clearance preferred; U.S. Person required, as defined under ITAR/EAR.

Soft Skills

Able to operate at the intersection of manufacturing operations and data engineering - translates shop floor requirements into integration designs.

Strong communicator across technical and non-technical audiences including operations leadership, compliance teams, and external vendors.

Detail-oriented with strong documentation habits; treats integration artifacts as auditable, production-grade deliverables.

Self-directed and proactive in regulated environments where data accuracy and system reliability directly impact production outcomes.

Collaborative - experienced working across IT, engineering, quality, compliance, and external implementation partners.

Preferred Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate

AWS Certified Data Analytics - Specialty

Dassault Systems / Delima Apriso platform certification (or equivalent MES vendor training)

NetSuite Suite Foundation or Administrator certification

CompTIA Security+ (preferred for environments with compliance requirements)

Working Conditions

Fully remote position; no geographical preference.

Occasional on-site visits to manufacturing facilities may be required during implementation phases and go-live support windows.

Occasional after-hours availability for system cutovers, integration deployments, and incident response.

Active participation in sprint-based delivery against a defined implementation roadmap.

Must comply with all applicable data handling, export control, and CUI policies.

Position Description:

As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will serve as the primary financial partner to the Products portfolio Business Manager, playing a pivotal role in shaping the financial performance of a fast-paced portfolio of defense and commercial contracts. This role will partner closely with Product Line VP/Directors, program management, operations, contracts, scheduling, EV management, and executive leadership to drive business performance, manage program profitability, and ensure accurate, timely financial data for decision-making.  You will go beyond routine reporting, providing actionable insights into EACs, forecasts, and risks/opportunities to drive profitability. This position requires a strong grasp of FAR/CAS and ensuring compliance with U.S. Government regulations and company policies.  The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in government contracting, cost accounting, and earned value management, along with proven leadership skills in a high-compliance environment.

Key Responsibilities

Program Finance Partnering: Act as the financial lead for assigned programs, directly supporting the LOB Manager with daily financial strategy, budgeting, and performance management.

Estimate at Complete (EAC): Lead the preparation and analysis of complex Quarterly Estimates at Complete (EAC) for FFP and Cost Reimbursement contracts to ensure accurate revenue and profit recognition.

Budgeting & Forecasting: Drive the monthly and annual budgeting process, variance analysis (actuals vs. plan), and long-range forecasts for the Line of Business.

Risk & Opportunity Management: Identify, track, and mitigate execution risks, forecasting impacts on program cost and schedule while identifying potential financial opportunities.

Reporting & Data Analysis: Develop advanced Excel/Power BI dashboards to provide high-level briefings on program health to senior leadership.

Compliance Champion: Ensure strict compliance with FAR, DFARS, CAS, and GAAP, ensuring all financial activities pass internal/external audits.

Proposal Support: Collaborate with Contracts, Business Development, and Proposal Operations to develop cost proposals, pricing strategies, and business case analyses.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.

8+ years of progressive finance experience, with at least 3 years in aerospace, defense, or other government contracting environments.

Deep understanding of FAR, DFARS, CAS regulations, and contract types.

Advanced proficiency in ERP/MRP systems and financial modeling and forecasting (e.g. NetSuite, ForProject, MS Project).

Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret Clearance (requires U.S. Citizenship)

Preferred:

Experience in both fixed-price and cost-reimbursable contract environments.

Working-level EVMS experience

Core Competencies

Strategic financial acumen with operational awareness.

Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly to non-financial stakeholders.

Ability to work independently while driving complete, on-time deliveries.

Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and deadlines.

High integrity and commitment to compliance.

Salary Range: $125,000-$175,000 per year

Please click “Apply” to submit your application.

title: Director, Member Data Science
description_text: About Foodsmart: Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money. Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases. At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment: 👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards. 🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards. 🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group. Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food. About the Role: We’re looking for a Director, Member Data Science to own the analytics behind the entire path a member takes with Foodsmart, from first contact, through activation, to long-term retention. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Clinical Operations along the way. This is a high-impact, domain-owning leadership role reporting to the VP of Analytics & Data Science. You’ll be the executive-facing voice on member funnel and retention performance, lead our experimentation and causal inference program, and build the attribution and lifecycle models that shape how Foodsmart invests across the member journey. You’ll partner directly with senior company leadership as the analytical voice understanding the member journey. You’ll lead a small team while staying hands-on yourself. This is a meaningfully technical role, not a pure people-management seat: we need someone who can build and review the models directly, operate as a trusted thought partner to executive stakeholders, and coach the team toward increasingly independent ownership. As this area grows, we expect that growth to come from leverage, not just headcount: real scale will come from how well you and your team use AI agents and tooling to extend your reach. If you’re energized by getting more out of a small team through scale of impact rather than by managing a bigger one, this is built for you. This is a full-stack data science leadership role. We’re not looking for a pure statistician or a pure analytics engineer. We need someone who operates across the entire analytical stack, from dbt source models and semantic layer design, to BI dashboards and self-service tooling, to predictive modeling, causal inference, and optimization work. At Foodsmart, durable insight requires owning the data foundation it sits on, and impactful models require the communication infrastructure to drive decisions. We expect this person to be strong across all of it, and to instill that same standard in the team they lead. We’re a small, flat, fast-moving team that leans hard into AI-native tooling. We use Hex and its AI Agent for analysis, and Omni with deep context engineering to power stakeholder self-service. We’re actively expanding our use of Claude Code across our workflows, and we want someone who treats these tools as force multipliers for their own output and their team’s, not someone who sees analytics as a hand-cranked request queue.

title: AI Enablement Specialist
description_text: About Fullscript We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care. That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment. We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better. This is your invitation. Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people. Join us and shape the future of care. The Opportunity Fullscript is looking for an AI Enablement Specialist to help Fullscripters use AI confidently, responsibly, and effectively in their day-to-day work. You will join Team GSD, Fullscript's AI and automation enablement team. GSD helps departments improve how work gets done by combining practical AI education, workflow discovery, and scalable automation. This role will own the human side of that work: turning fast-moving AI capabilities and internal tools into clear, useful learning experiences that meet people where they are. This is primarily a content, enablement, and adoption role. You will build the self-serve resources, interactive learning experiences, communications, and support models that help teams learn independently. You will also work with stakeholders to uncover workflow pain points, assess AI and automation opportunities, and translate what you learn into clear inputs for the GSD roadmap. You will not be expected to build machine learning models or act as a full-time trainer. You should, however, be hands-on and credible with modern AI tools, curious about how people learn, and comfortable facilitating a live session or webinar when it is the best way to help a group move forward. What you'll do Own the creation of Fullscript’s AI training and development content, including practical guides, slide decks, blogs, videos, playbooks, templates, and role-based learning paths. Build and continuously improve interactive, self-serve learning experiences that make Fullscript’s AI knowledge easy to find, understand, and apply independently. Identify user groups, learning needs, and skill gaps across Fullscript, then tailor content to their workflows, business context, and level of AI fluency. Stay current on AI tools, capabilities, use cases, and emerging trends, using that knowledge to keep Fullscript’s learning materials accurate, relevant, and practical. Partner with AI Champions to shape departmental adoption roadmaps, equip them with reusable resources, and support the rollout and internal go-to-market of new AI tools. Build strong relationships across the business, observe how teams work, and uncover operational pain points, knowledge gaps, and opportunities for AI or automation. Gather requirements and frame opportunities by documenting the problem, users, current workflow, expected impact, data needs, feasibility, and risk, then translate those insights into clear recommendations for GSD roadmap planning. Serve as a frontline enablement partner for GSD applications, turning recurring questions, adoption barriers, and user feedback into better content, product guidance, and roadmap inputs. Measure and improve enablement through signals such as content engagement, tool usage, proficiency, support trends, time saved, and business impact. Facilitate select workshops, webinars, office hours, or onboarding sessions, share useful practices across teams, and occasionally represent Fullscript at relevant industry events. What you bring to the table Experience in learning and development, technical enablement, digital learning, knowledge management, change enablement, developer education, or a related field. Hands-on fluency with modern AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar platforms, along with a practical understanding of what large language models can and cannot do. Experience designing clear, engaging learning content for people with different roles, levels of technical knowledge, and ways of learning. A track record of building self-serve resources or digital learning experiences that improved adoption, confidence, or performance. Strong business analysis skills. You can uncover the real problem behind a request, map a workflow, gather requirements, and translate business needs into clear next steps for a technical team. Excellent written communication and information design skills, with the judgment to make complex ideas simple without making them inaccurate. Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to earn trust with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to move several enablement initiatives forward without losing sight of quality or outcomes. A practical, people-first approach to change. You understand that adoption depends on relevance, trust, clarity, and support, not simply access to a new tool. Comfort facilitating a live learning session, webinar, or group discussion when needed. Bonus if you have Experience with low-code or no-code automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, or Make. Experience creating interactive learning experiences or lightweight web applications using low-code, no-code, or AI-assisted development tools. Familiarity with AI workflow concepts such as agents, connectors, model selection, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop review. Experience launching internal tools or leading adoption and communication programs in a technology-driven organization. This is a high-agency, low-process role. You won’t wait for specs. You’ll define problems, make decisions, and move fast with strong engineering judgment.Your work will directly shape how we build, scale, and accelerate software using AI.

title: Software Engineer II, Agentic AI
description_text: About Us Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response. Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats. Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com. Role Summary As a member of the Sophos Agentic AI team, the Software Engineer II designs, builds and supports reliable AI-powered cybersecurity capabilities. The role applies sound software engineering practices to moderately scoped, varied assignments, collaborating with experienced engineers and cross-functional partners to deliver secure, scalable services and customer value.

title: Business Analyst (freelance)
description_text: Viseven Group — міжнародна MarTech компанія, що спеціалізується на інтерактивному контенті та хмарних рішеннях для глобальних фармацевтичних компаній з 2009 року. Постійне зростання та саморозвиток закладені в нашій корпоративній ДНК. Наші унікальні розробки та підходи активно використовуються більш ніж у 50 країнах світу. Рішення Viseven представлені на великих галузевих заходах у Барселоні, Філадельфії, Лондоні тощо. Команда, яка швидко зростає, включає понад 700+ висококваліфікованих технічних і нетехнічних експертів: front- і back-end розробників, BA фахівців та менеджерів, які створюють, локалізують і налаштовують програми у офісах по всьому світу: Житомир (Україна), Таллінн (Естонія), Нью-Делі (Індія), Бриджвотер (США). Опис ролі: Ми шукаємо Business Analyst для фріланс-кооперації (до 20 годин на тиждень) терміном на 3 місяці з можливістю продовження. Роль передбачає роботу з комерційним напрямом нашого продукту eWizard - це AI-powered SaaS платформа для управління цифровим контентом, створена для глобальних фармацевтичних компаній. Вона дозволяє швидко створювати, локалізувати та дистрибутувати омніканальний контент з повним дотриманням регуляторних вимог і інтеграцією в MarTech-екосистему клієнта.

title: Business Analyst (freelance)
description_text: Viseven Group is a leading global B2B MarTech service provider, empowering Pharma and LifeScience companies since 2009. Our mission is to drive digital transformation and excellence, offering comprehensive end-to-end software and digital marketing services tailored to the pharmaceutical industry. The company's solutions, products, and services are actively used by the top 100 Pharma and Life Science companies. At Viseven, our rapidly growing team boasts over 700 highly skilled professionals, including experts in development, design, business analysis, project management, delivery, sales, marketing, and customer success. With a global footprint in more than 30 countries across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC, and physical offices in Ukraine, Poland, Estonia, India, and the US, we are well-positioned to serve our diverse clientele. Join us and become part of a pioneering team dedicated to shaping the future of digital transformation in Pharma and Life Sciences across more than 50 countries around the globe. Job Description: We are looking for a business analyst to work on a freelance basis (up to 20 hours per week) for an initial 3-month period, with the possibility of extension. The role involves working on the commercial side of our product, eWizard—an AI-powered SaaS platform for digital content management designed for global pharmaceutical companies. It enables the rapid creation, localization, and distribution of omnichannel content in full compliance with regulatory requirements and integration into the client’s MarTech ecosystem.
